## Pull Request Checklist

Before submitting your PR, please verify the following:
- [ ] Added or updated tests if appropriate.
- [ ] Ensured all CI checks pass (`npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`).
- [ ] Updated the `[Unreleased]` section of `CHANGELOG.md` if this changes public behavior.
- [ ] Checked that `npm run build` succeeds locally.
